prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func ReconcileLedger(opening int64, entries [][3]int64) (int64, bool)
Behavior: Each entry is (unique id, kind, positive amount), where kind 1 credits and -1 debits. Reject duplicate ids, other kinds, non-positive amounts, and unsafe arithmetic where applicable; otherwise return opening plus all signed amounts.
Visible example: opening 100 with (7,credit,25) and (8,debit,40) reconciles to 85; repeating id 7 is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func ReconcileLedger(opening int64,entries [][3]int64)(int64,bool){seen:=map[int64]bool{};b:=opening;for _,e:=range entries{if seen[e[0]]||e[2]<=0||(e[1]!=1&&e[1]!=-1){return 0,false};seen[e[0]]=true;if e[1]==1{b+=e[2]}else{b-=e[2]}};return b,true}
